# HIGH RISK FOR SURGICAL SITE INFECTIONS ANTIBIOTIC PROPHYLAXIS

Antibiotic prophylaxis is recommended for prevention of infection for the listed

high risk conditions:

1. Extensive inflammatory skin disease (e.g. high tension)

2. Groin or Lower Extremities

3. Skin flaps and grafts

4. Wedge excision of lip or ear

Contaminated, dirty or infected wound may warrant antibiotic prophylaxis if

patient is not currently on an antimicrobial for treatment of infection at the

surgical site. Surgical prophylaxis is covered by antimicrobials for treatment

of infection at time of surgery. No additional antimicrobials are necessary.

# Preferred

[Cephalexin 2 GM PO ONCE - 1 hour prior to procedure \($\) R](psjzid-cephalexin-2gm-po-once-c)

# MRSA risk factor

[Trimethoprim/Sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO 60 minutes before incision \($\)](orz-set-abx-op-tmp-smx-1-ds-tab-po-once-penvk-500mg-po-once)

[R,DI] < AND > penicillin VK 500 mg PO 60 minutes before incision ($) [R]

# Unable to take oral medications

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

# MRSA risk factors and unable to take oral medications

[Vancomycin 15mg/kg Weight Based Dosing Preop R](orzid2-gmenu-surg-vancomycin-weight-based-dosing)
